suggestions: I'm grateful for a PR that merged clean on the first try, no back-and-forth needed.
I'm thankful for the uncle at the kopitiam who remembers my order without asking.
I'm grateful for catching a bug in code review before it ever touched production.
I'm thankful for the breeze right after the rain, when the haze finally clears off the city.
I'm grateful for a manager who actually said no to the client's unreasonable deadline for once.
I'm thankful for the stretch of quiet after the Maghrib azan when the whole house slows down.
I'm grateful for a nasi lemak that's just the right amount of spicy on a rough Monday.
I'm thankful for a car that started on the first try during a thunderstorm.
I'm grateful for a test suite that actually caught the regression instead of me finding it in prod.
I'm thankful for having enough left in the bank this month to send some back home.
I'm grateful for a colleague who covered my on-call shift without making it a whole negotiation.
I'm thankful for the smell of my grandmother's kitchen whenever I visit on a Sunday.
I'm grateful for a flaky CI pipeline that finally, finally went green after the third rerun.
I'm thankful for the LRT actually being on time when I'm already running late.
I'm grateful for a long drive back from kampung with good music and nobody in a rush.
